scope.summary: Implement NGL-structured garment planning tool that transforms a natural-language operator brief into a NGL intermediate description (garment category, neckline, sleeve length, fit, ease, layer count) before panel shape generation, and inject it into ContextBundle.ngl_description
acceptance_criteria: A NglGarmentDescription struct is defined capturing: garment_category, neckline, collar, sleeve_length, sleeve_type, length, fit (tight/regular/oversized), ease_cm, layer_count, material_hint
TailorModelAdapter invokes an NGL planning pass (via LlmClient) before panel-shape generation: operator_brief -> NglGarmentDescription -> GarmentSpec panels
NglGarmentDescription is serializable and is stored in ContextBundle.ngl_description and in GarmentSpec.natural_description for session handoff
When reference_spec_id is non-null in ContextBundle, the NGL planning pass produces a delta description (what changes from the reference, not a full re-plan)
Multi-layer outfits (layer_count > 1) produce a GarmentSpec with panels grouped by layer, enabling the multi-layer collision ordering required by the Collision group
The NGL intermediate is emitted as a TailorPanelAiEditProposalRecorded event before panels are finalized so the operator can inspect the plan

Pattern Drafter edit mode exposes source image, scale/calibration, editable points/curves, constraints, uncertainty, preview, accept/reject, and recovery through the shared command and surface registries.
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core tailor::ngl_planner::brief_to_ngl (operator brief produces valid NglGarmentDescription)
cargo test -p handshake_core tailor::model_adapter::ngl_to_spec_roundtrip (NGL description + template produces panels passing PANEL_CLOSURE)
cargo test -p handshake_core tailor::model_adapter::multilayer_ngl (layer_count=2 produces correctly grouped panels)
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the NGL planning intermediate, models jump directly from free-text operator brief to vertex coordinates. This produces noisy, geometrically inconsistent panels requiring many more self-correction iterations. The NGL step is what makes multi-layer outfits and complex garment categories feasible via a single author_garment call. Skipping it eliminates the no-training NGL-Prompter advantage that distinguishes Handshake from vanilla ChatGarment fine-tuning.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Solver/backend/schema producer only. It exposes typed state, diagnostics, receipts, and TraceProjection; the named native workspace owner consumes it without widening this MT's allowed paths.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Model and agent operation

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

required_changes_before_execution: Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
